defects.where: dossier: session.date.note, carrier.catalogue.note, transfer.date.note, rights and source locators
defects.problem: Numerous prose words are accidentally joined to dates or identifiers, impairing the public dossier’s readability.
defects.evidence: Examples include to3–4December1955, a1956, in1918, in1956, before1963 and former50-year. The underlying dates and provenance were independently checked.
defects.fix: Restore normal spaces throughout dossier prose: for example to 3–4 December 1955, in 1956, before 1963 and former 50-year. Space catalogue references and month/year phrases without changing exact machine identifiers, URLs or ISO dates.
